title: No Pod activation possible since Android 16 Update
body:
Did the Pixel Android 16 Update Yesterday. 
Connection to Dash wored fine so far.
Today i tried a Pod change. 
Deactivating old Dash worked fine.
But there is no Activation for New Pod possibe

Bonding Mode didn't work too

What are possibilitiea to check?

comments.body:
Adding my findings. 

My phone is a Pixel 7 Pro. Running Android 15 until today with no issues on the Dash pods. I was never using the Dash bond setting.

Today I updated to Android 16, and the current pod continued to work with no settings change in AAPS.

Then I deactivated the current pod and tried to activate a new pod. The pod fails to activate with the following error:  "Failed to connect to pod"

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/466797e2-4f4a-4020-9fee-8da4acd12a51)

The logcat shows the following:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/000be122-a991-45a1-8f80-37a69b8d3c91)

It fails waiting for the connection here:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6ec5eba5-c57d-4754-915b-22e2647f1e0d)

This is so weird, because the same function call is used for active pods, so why was it working earlier in the day for me, but now is failing with a new pod? I also tried bonding the pod manually in the android settings and it still fails to co

Trying to experiment with your main diabetes phone is foolish thing... And upgrading to unsupported system is very foolish thing... There have been a lot of reports of different drivers/pumps not working with Android 15, and you go and upgrade to system (Android 16), that is even less supported...

Thanks @nickb24 workarount also works for me.
nice find.

short night so this will not happen again

thanks to the team for finding a solution that quick
hopefully there will be a dev version or a release soon
